metadata.title: बैगा जनजाति: युवती-युवक कैसे जीवन साथी चुनते हैं | Baiga Tribe | Adivasi Marriage |  Baiga Dance
metadata.description: The Baigas, followers of an ancient cultural tradition, consider themselves the first humans on Earth. Their performing arts, particularly the Baiga dance and songs, serve as custodians of their fast-disappearing cultural heritage. In this episode of Main Bhi Bharat, the focus is on the Dussehra Nach (Dasara Dance) of the Baiga tribe. This dance ritual, spanning from October to Holi, involves groups of girls or boys visiting each other's villages for two days. Throughout the nights, these groups engage in lively dances, providing an opportunity for Baiga individuals to find love partners, potentially leading to marriages. The performance showcases the significance of these cultural practices in preserving the unique identity and traditions of the Baiga community amid challenges such as migration, acculturation, and societal changes over time.
